from pathlib import Path
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    divider_cells = set()
    for r in sep_rows:
        for c in range(w): divider_cells.add((r,c))
    for c in sep_cols:
        for r in range(h): divider_cells.add((r,c))
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if (r,c) not in divider_cells)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        row_out = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            has_mark = any(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            row_out.append(1 if has_mark else 2)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
'''

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    divider_cells = {(r,c) for r in sep_rows for c in range(w)} | {(r,c) for c in sep_cols for r in range(h)}
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if (r,c) not in divider_cells)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        row_out = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            markers = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            row_out.append(1 if markers >= 2 else background)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
'''
